elite.diaithirbosses.name: Kuraid %s %s
boss.diaithirbosses.cooldown: The altar is cold. It wakes again in %s minutes.
boss.diaithirbosses.offering: The altar wants one champion token.
boss.diaithirbosses.rush_locked: Beat every Ascendant I boss before the rush.
boss.diaithirbosses.rush_start: The rush begins: %s bosses, no rest.
ritual.diaithirbosses.antlered_hollow.0: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.
ritual.diaithirbosses.antlered_hollow.1: The hollow king shed his crown among the bones of the old herd. Lay sixteen at the foot of the stone.
ritual.diaithirbosses.antlered_hollow.2: The dead of the wood walk his old trail. Let twenty fall in sight of the altar.
ritual.diaithirbosses.antlered_hollow.3: Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the door-wood, the strong one; then the one that bleeds when it is cut; then red berries set against the witch.
ritual.diaithirbosses.antlered_hollow.4: The stone will answer only when the moon stands highest over the stone. Use the altar then.
ritual.diaithirbosses.cauldron_heart.0: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.
ritual.diaithirbosses.cauldron_heart.1: What boils in the heart must first be fed. Sixteen red-bark warts for the pot.
ritual.diaithirbosses.cauldron_heart.2: Eight-legged cooks stir the lower dark. Twenty of them must be unmade.
ritual.diaithirbosses.cauldron_heart.3: Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the door-wood, the strong one; then the pale one that wears the first white; then the winter king, green when all is grey; then the one that bleeds when it is cut.
ritual.diaithirbosses.cauldron_heart.4: The stone will answer only in the breath between night and the first light. Use the altar then.
ritual.diaithirbosses.tide_reaver.0: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.
ritual.diaithirbosses.tide_reaver.1: The drowned reaver's coat is made of sea-glass. Twenty-four shards, and no fewer.
ritual.diaithirbosses.tide_reaver.2: The sea gives back its dead on the shore. Fifteen must go back to it.
ritual.diaithirbosses.tide_reaver.3: Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: kin of the tree that holds up the world; then the nut of the one who knows; then the one that bleeds when it is cut; then the nut of the one who knows.
ritual.diaithirbosses.tide_reaver.4: The stone will answer only as the sun drowns and the first stars wake. Use the altar then.
The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.
The Sovereign's hearth wants iron by the block: eight, cold and square.
Bones that never rusted still march in his smoke. Thirty is the count.

Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the weeper by the water; then the nut of the one who knows; then kin of the tree that holds up the world; then the winter king, green when all is grey; then red berries set against the witch.
The stone will answer only when no shadow falls beside the stone. Use the altar then.
It will not wake for one hand. 2 must stand at the altar together, or the stone will take a token for every spirit that stands in for a friend.

ritual.diaithirbosses.mist_weaver.1: The weaver spins in the dark of what you carry. Sixty-four threads for her loom.
ritual.diaithirbosses.mist_weaver.2: Her children cover the old roads. Thirty of them fewer.
ritual.diaithirbosses.mist_weaver.3: Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the weeper by the water; then the door-wood, the strong one; then the one that bleeds when it is cut; then kin of the tree that holds up the world; then red berries set against the witch.

ritual.diaithirbosses.ash_seraph.1: A bright thing fell and burned to powder. Thirty-two pinches to call it back.
ritual.diaithirbosses.ash_seraph.2: The sun-dried dead keep its old watch. Twenty-five must be put to rest.
ritual.diaithirbosses.ash_seraph.3: Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the one that bleeds when it is cut; then the gate the Fair Folk keep; then the weeper by the water; then the winter king, green when all is grey; then kin of the tree that holds up the world.

ritual.diaithirbosses.ash_seraph.5: It will not wake for one hand. 2 must stand at the altar together, or the stone will take a token for every spirit that stands in for a friend.

ritual.diaithirbosses.dusk_wyrm.1: The wyrm sleeps behind the eyes of the end-walkers. Twelve eyes, open, on the stone.
ritual.diaithirbosses.dusk_wyrm.2: The sleepless sky-things are its scouts. Ten must fall.
ritual.diaithirbosses.dusk_wyrm.3: Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. ritual.diaithirbosses.dusk_wyrm.5: It will not wake for one hand. 3 must stand at the altar together, or the stone will take a token for every spirit that stands in for a friend.
ritual.diaithirbosses.rootbreaker.0: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.
ritual.diaithirbosses.rootbreaker.1: The roots remember being amber. Sixteen bricks of what they wept.
ritual.diaithirbosses.rootbreaker.2: Axe-bearers cleared the grove that bore it. Fifteen must answer.
ritual.diaithirbosses.rootbreaker.3: Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the pale one that wears the first white; then the door-wood, the strong one; then the pale one that wears the first white; then the door-wood, the strong one; then the gate the Fair Folk keep; then the pale one that wears the first white.

ritual.diaithirbosses.rootbreaker.5: It will not wake for one hand. 3 must stand at the altar together, or the stone will take a token for every spirit that stands in for a friend.
ritual.diaithirbosses.last_wheel.0: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.
ritual.diaithirbosses.last_wheel.1: The Wheel is wound by small wheels. Twelve clocks, wound and ticking.
ritual.diaithirbosses.last_wheel.2: Those who step between moments are its spokes. Twenty spokes must break.
ritual.diaithirbosses.last_wheel.3: Nine trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the pale one that wears the first white; then the nut of the one who knows; then the weeper by the water; then the nut of the one who knows; then the pale one that wears the first white; then the one that bleeds when it is cut; then the door-wood, the strong one.
ritual.diaithirbosses.last_wheel.4: The stone will answer only when the moon stands highest over the stone. Use the altar then.
ritual.diaithirbosses.last_wheel.5: It will not wake for one hand. 3 must stand at the altar together, or the stone will take a token for every spirit that stands in for a friend.
ritual.diaithirbosses.begin: The altar stirs. Something has heard you.
ritual.diaithirbosses.step_done: A knot in the rite is tied.
ritual.diaithirbosses.done: The rite is whole. The ground answers.
ritual.diaithirbosses.silent: The altar is silent. Hold a champion token to begin the next rite, or the trophy of a boss you have beaten to face it again.
ritual.diaithirbosses.wrong_hour: The stone does not answer at this hour.
ritual.diaithirbosses.need_company: It will not wake for one hand. %s must stand at the altar, %s still missing. Give a champion token for each spirit that will stand in.
ritual.diaithirbosses.defend_start: The waves come. Hold the altar for %s seconds.
ritual.diaithirbosses.defend_failed: The altar was left alone. The rite unravels to the start of this step.
ritual.diaithirbosses.rune_bad: A wrong rune. The sequence breaks and the stones remember it.
ritual.diaithirbosses.rune_idle: Nothing is listening for this rune.
boss.diaithirbosses.overworld_only: The altar only answers in the overworld.
